newsitem.title: UK: Cuban central bank -no plan to hurry on Paris Club.
newsitem.headline: Cuban central bank -no plan to hurry on Paris Club.

text.p: Cuba would like to find a long-term solution for the debt owed to the Paris Club but it has no intention to hurry the matter, Francisco Soberon, president of the Cuban central bank said on Wednesday.
"We are interested in finding a solution definitely but it has to be a real solution. We are not in a hurry regarding that problem," Soberon told Reuters in an interview.

The Central Bank president, who visited several European countries on his trip, said he had not met with any officials to discuss the country's Paris Club arrears. "We did not have the intention to make any contact with the Paris Club," Soberon said. But he noted there had been contact with the Paris Club in the past.
Soberon said Cuba's total external debt, which includes Paris Club debt, amounted to $10.4 billion and had not risen in 1996.
"It (Cuba) is an important market and a lot of people realise that and like to do business with us irrespective of whether the debt is refinanced or not," he said.
